name: 32310 · Tallahassee, FL
findings: ZIP 32310 (Tallahassee) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32310 (Tallahassee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32310 (Tallahassee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
